## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` pass (backend)
- [ ] `pytest` passes (backend)
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run test` and `npm run build` pass (frontend)
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files or databases are included
- [ ] Documentation was updated if behaviour or configuration changed
- [ ] New behaviour is covered by a test where practical
